headline_marked: Harry Kane's brace secures [[England's spot in World Cup last 16]] after comeback win
headline: Harry Kane's brace secures England's spot in World Cup last 16 after comeback win
summary: England overcame a first-half deficit to beat DR Congo 2-1, with Captain Harry Kane scoring twice to seal their progression.
details: Captain Harry Kane scored twice to lead England to a 2-1 victory over the Democratic Republic of Congo on Wednesday, securing their place in the World Cup round of 16.
DR Congo took a shock lead in the seventh minute when Brian Cipenga scored a low strike that beat goalkeeper Jordan Pickford at the near post.
England struggled to equalize up until the 75th minute, when Kane headed home a cross from Anthony Gordon to bring the game level.
The captain continued his rescue mission four minutes from time, rifling home the winner to complete his brace and secure the win.

The match was marked by several close calls, including a goal-bound effort from Marcus Rashford blocked by Aaron Wan-Bissaka and a Congolese keeper Lionel Mpasi making key saves from Jude Bellingham and Kane.
England is now set to face Mexico on Sunday at the Azteca Stadium for their last 16 clash.
caption:
From a goal down to the last 16! Harry Kane's late brace rescues England in a battling 2-1 win over DR Congo.

Captain Harry Kane scored twice to lead England to a 2-1 victory over the Democratic Republic of Congo on Wednesday, securing their place in the World Cup round of 16.

DR Congo took a shock lead in the seventh minute when Brian Cipenga scored a low strike that beat goalkeeper Jordan Pickford at the near post.

England struggled to equalize up until the 75th minute, when Kane headed home a cross from Anthony Gordon to bring the game level.

The captain continued his rescue mission four minutes from time, rifling home the winner to complete his brace and secure the win.

The match was marked by several close calls, including a goal-bound effort from Marcus Rashford blocked by Aaron Wan-Bissaka and a Congolese keeper Lionel Mpasi making key saves from Jude Bellingham and Kane.

England is now set to face Mexico on Sunday at the Azteca Stadium for their last 16 clash.

headline_marked: 4 youths [[beaten and hair cut]] at Jubodal leader's office in Rajshahi
headline: 4 youths beaten and hair cut at Jubodal leader's office in Rajshahi
summary: The victims were allegedly detained and tortured over theft accusations, with videos of the incident circulating on social media.
details: Four young men were detained and tortured at the office of a Jubodal leader in Rajshahi over allegations of theft.
The victims were reportedly beaten and had their hair forcibly cut while being held captive.
Videos documenting the abuse have since spread across various social media platforms, sparking public outcry.
The incident occurred after the youths were accused of stealing, leading to their detention in the leader's office.
